text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Fufufu♪ Next, we add some soy sauce and let it simmer thoroughly, and... done.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Oh?
Your hands look redder than usual...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
...! Come to think of it, lately
I've been washing the dishes in the sink.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Since I stand in the public eye, I must pay attention down to the finest details...
Satono Diamond was troubled by rough skin...
